note: Field test results for T-CARRIER. Carrier Test 1 requires a physical SIM; marked NOT_VERIFIED until executed on a physical SIM. Dial ##002# afterwards to undo all call forwarding.

gate_1_decision.rule: If Test 2 (App Rejection) and Test 3 (Caller ID Retention) pass 3/3 on at least one carrier, build app mode. Otherwise cut app mode from demo and show basic mode only.
gate_1_decision.verdict: App mode cut from demo; showing Basic Mode only. Carrier Test 1 marked NOT_VERIFIED (no physical SIM in automated test environment; dial ##002# after any SIM test to cancel all forwarding).

test_1_manual_decline.description: Carrier Test 1: forwarding to agent (**21* / **67*), then dial ##002# to undo forwarding

test_2_app_rejection.description: CallScreeningService rejection triggers carrier busy forward (**67*)

test_3_caller_id_retention.description: Original caller ID is preserved in Bolna webhook across forward

test_4_unanswered_rollover.description: Unanswered call after 25s rolls over to agent (**61*)
